rules.quote: 2.1 Only the hourly rates approved in the rate schedule for the matter may be billed.
2.2 Time recorded by summer associates and law clerks is not billable to Kestrel Logistics AG, whatever the task.
2.4 No more than two (2) timekeepers may bill for attending the same deposition without prior approval.
2.5 No more than two (2) timekeepers may bill for attending the same hearing or court appearance without prior approval.
3.1 Time must be recorded in increments of one-tenth of an hour (0.1).
Block billing (several tasks in one entry) is not permitted; block-billed entries will be reduced by 50%.
Vague entries such as "attention to file", "work on matter" or "research" without a subject will be rejected.
3.4 A timekeeper may not bill more than 10 hours in a single day on our matters without prior written approval.
4.1 Administrative and clerical work is overhead and is not billable, whoever performs it.
4.2 Where timekeepers of the firm confer internally, only the most senior attendee may bill the time; time recorded by other attendees of the same conference is not billable.
5.1 Non-working travel time may be billed at 50% of the timekeeper's approved rate.
6.1 The following are firm overheads and will not be reimbursed: word processing and meals.
6.2 Photocopying is reimbursed at no more than EUR 0.10 per page.
7.2 Invoices must be submitted within 60 days of the end of the billing period.
7.3 Fees beyond the approved matter budget require written approval from the responsible in-house lawyer before the work is performed.
